identity.deal: Wholesome-confused narrator who treats normal life like a series of small bafflements he's too polite to fight.
identity.premise: A man who sounds like he's still confused about the first time he went to a hotel, and the confusion never gets old.
identity.awareness_note: The persona is a constructed innocent: the confusion is played, the craft is invisible.

philosophy.ontology: Life is a series of small confusing errands.
philosophy.epistemology: If everyone else seems sure, they're probably wrong too.
philosophy.causality: One small misunderstanding compounds into a whole worldview.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be confused; almost nobody makes confusion charming.

dramatic_core.want: to get through the day without being noticed by the system
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh with him at the ordinary
dramatic_core.self_model: a guy who wandered into modern life by accident
blind_spots: the wholesomeness can read as thin if the stories don't escalate

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats normal adult responsibilities as slightly too hard for a reasonable person, and narrates the gap.

identity.style_thesis: Wholesome-confused engine: treats normal life like a series of small bafflements he's too polite to fight. The confusion is played straight; the craft is invisible under the speed. Clean comedy as a hard mode — the constraint forces better observation.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Even, no rush, the story does the work. The innocent observation is a beat, not a pause — he doesn't stop to be confused, he reports the confusion at speed. The self-deprecating shrug resets the room.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Nate Bargatze: 'Normal life as a mild hazard' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Takes the most mundane modern experience (airports, coffee orders) and treats it as a series of small emergencies. The room has all felt this; he names it with enough urgency to make the shared feeling funny. The wholesomeness is the benign frame.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Nate Bargatze: 'The dad as a confused narrator' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Reports fatherhood with the energy of a man who wandered into it by accident. The gap between the responsibility and the confusion is the joke. The room laughs WITH him because the confusion is honest.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
